title: Childhood maltreatment and the developing brain: toward individualized models of psychiatric risk
title_zh: 童年虐待与大脑发育：迈向个体化精神疾病风险模型
abstract: Childhood maltreatment shapes brain development in ways that vary by adversity type, developmental timing, and genetic vulnerability to psychiatric illness-a heterogeneity that conventional approaches capture poorly. We contend that normative modeling, multivariate methods, and polygenic risk scores offer complementary frameworks for parsing this variability and advancing mechanistic insights and clinical stratification.
abstract_zh: 童年虐待以不同的逆境类型、发育时机和对精神疾病的遗传易感性塑造大脑发育——这是一种传统方法难以充分捕捉的异质性。我们认为，规范化建模、多变量方法和多基因风险评分为解析这种变异性、推进机制洞察和临床分层提供了互补的框架。
